implementation_notes: The compiler makes the third-occurrence extraction cheap and safe: write the third copy, then replace all three with a generic function over the differing type or a trait method for the differing step.
idiom_name: third copy -> generic fn / trait method, retrofitted safely
code_sketch:
fn normalise<T: Normalise>(items: &[T]) -> Vec<T::Out> { items.iter().map(T::normalise).collect() }

trait Normalise { type Out; fn normalise(&self) -> Self::Out; }
pitfalls: Generic parameter used at one monomorphic call site
Trait with a single blanket impl written speculatively
